title: BoardGameGeek Hotness
content:
1. **Greenwood**
*2026*
Gather companions from different clans to free the mystical creatures of Greenwood.
![Greenwood](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-10-29/toplist/bgg_be473201.jpg)

2. **Queen Alice**
*2026*
Rivals in the court strive to crown Alice as the White or the Red Queen.
![Queen Alice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-10-29/toplist/bgg_66e75910.jpg)

3. **Kingdom Come: Deliverance – The Board Game**
*2026*
Develop your character, fulfill quests, and shape history in 15th-century Bohemia.
![Kingdom Come: Deliverance – The Board Game](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-10-29/toplist/bgg_b2efe399.png)

4. **-60°**
*2026*
Lead an expedition to the meteorite impact site.
![-60°](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-10-29/toplist/bgg_021b2d75.png)

5. **Kalypso**
*2026*
Salvage debris to build a floating settlement in a world swallowed by the sea.
![Kalypso](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-10-29/toplist/bgg_11046e8f.png)

6. **Harmonies: Crescendo**
*2026*

7. **Timespan**
*2026*

8. **Melodies**
*2026*

9. **Drillers**
*2026*

*2026*

*2026*
